test_results.affected_subset: 34 test files that spawn herdr, kubectl, helm or argocd, use hook Redis keys or the moved config variables: 1776 passed with two workers at 964cf2c4

authority: test fixtures take no actor input; a fixture grant is its run id, written to the root marker and the Redis owner key, and only that run id may sweep or remove what it created
rollback_rehearsal: on a throwaway checkout at the reviewed code head, reverting every package commit back to the merge base leaves no file different from the merge base, and the previous suite guards still pass
rollback_rehearsal_output: $ git diff --stat a8e17acc (tree after revert vs merge base)
rollback_command: revert the pull request; the package stores no state outside the repository and each test run's temporary roots and Redis keys belong to that run only
limitations: Only keys built by the hooks package carry the per run prefix; the swarm, inbox and gate stores keep production agentihooks names and are tested against a per test fakeredis. Changing them is production code, outside this package's scope.
The fixture Redis boundary is a socket inside the fixture root, database 15 and the run prefix; no dedicated Redis user is created.
No default kubectl fake is installed: a missing binary fails as missing and a real one is refused; tests install their own fakes.
A program started by os.spawn* or named only by a shell variable's run time value is not seen; os.spawn* raises no audit event.
Where a real kubectl, helm, argocd or herdr is installed, a shell command naming one as an argument is refused too.
